body:
My friend and I drove from LA to San Diego to pick up a lot of different kinds of drugs. We came to our dealer to discover that instead of LSD 25 he only had ALD 52 and DOC so we ended up buying around 100 hits of ALD 52, 4 pills of DiPT, 10 grams of top shelf indicud, xanax, 30 grams of dried mushrooms and this English beer had.
We drove back to LA to my house and dropped a hit each around 22.00 pm. 250 uq in each tab. We went on a golf cart ride and drove to this spot were you could see the golf course and the mountains, after about 30 mins of endless driving around the neighborhood it felt like the trip was similar to a mushroom high but in the same time it felt different, like something so unique almost like a cartoon.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
The acid started to hit heavy around 12.00 pm. I started thinking that someone or something was trying to kill us so I politely asked to be driven back to my house. We came back to the house and I jumped in the pool. I was in the swimming pool probably for 2-3 hours listening to my friend talk about Vietnam, 60's, Grateful Dead, mafia and all kinds of crazy things. The music was nuts!!! Gorillaz, daft punk, the knife, crystal castles all these amazing bands were playing through my house speakers, it felt like I was on an island (the actual plastic beach!).
Around 2.00 am. my friend dropped the second hit (250 uq) and around 3.00 am. I got out of the pool and started eating deserts it felt like my eyes were replaced with fish eyes and I could see everything. My friend explained that it was because of my pupils, they were huge! I dropped the second hit around 3.30 am. and went into the room with the speakers, layed on the floor and started seeing Bryan cranston's face appear on the carpet, it was big, the music got too loud and suddenly I got scared. My friend was moving a golf cart outside and making these loud noises witch too me it seemed like he was breaking the golf cart. I couldn't fee my body, it felt as if my head was disconnecting from my body and I stoped feeling funny and nice, I started feeling like I can't control the trip anymore. Everything looked big, the phases, the sky was 7 different colors, everything was moving. I felt like a psychedelic soldier, I layed on the grass hearing everything!!!! Every single little sound, insects, grass. I jumped in the pool but it was cold. I got out ansd as I was running to take a shower I saw he bubbles in the hot tub turn into evil pigs that were swimming in my pool. My friend who was completely dressed told me that I looked scared and cold. We sat outside the whole morning.
I felt the acid was getting stronger, the lights were intense, the colors were crazy. I felt like I was going insane. I kept asking when is it going to end, my friend said he didn't know, he said if by 17.00 pm. I wouldn't sober up he would call the ambulance. I felt normal the whole time in my head. I just wanted it to end. He gave me some beer, I drank 10 bottles and got wasted. I jumped in the pool and it was fun again. I went to bed promising that I would be eve do acid again. Woke up at 21.00 pm. and took it again!
